About

EcoLoop AI is a product vision for sustainable building operations.

The project blends AI reasoning, simulation rigor, and enterprise-grade software engineering to improve how buildings consume energy.

Mission

Make energy optimization readable, explainable, and actionable.

EcoLoop AI turns complex simulation and orchestration systems into a product experience that building operators, sustainability leaders, and technical stakeholders can all understand.
